layout.arrangement: White slide enclosed by a thin red rectangular frame inset ~4% from all edges. Title 'At Hidden Layer' (red, bold, underlined) at top-left; a small yellow circle badge with purple outline containing '21' at top-right. Below the title, a large red-outlined panel occupying the upper-left ~72% of the slide width contains a feed-forward neural-network diagram (three input nodes on the left, one hidden node in the center, three output nodes on the right) with a pale-green, blue-bordered equation strip running horizontally across the lower part of that panel. A second, smaller red-outlined white box sits at the bottom-left of the slide, below the main panel, holding the simplified weight-update equation and the 'Where:' definition line. The right side of the lower half of the slide is empty white space.

layout.hierarchy: The red underlined title is the strongest element by color and weight. The large red-framed diagram panel dominates the upper-left two-thirds of the slide through its size and the network of red arrows. The pale-green equation strip is the second focal point because of its contrasting fill and multi-color (black/blue/green/red) formula. The bottom-left definition box is secondary, smaller and mostly black/red/green text. The yellow '21' badge is a small but high-contrast accent in the top-right corner.

typography_notes: Title is a bold sans-serif (Arial/Verdana-like) in red with a red underline, noticeably larger than all other text. All mathematical symbols and node/weight labels are set in a bold italic serif face (Times New Roman-like), with subscripts rendered smaller and lowered. The word 'Where:' in the bottom box is set in a regular (non-italic) black serif, smaller than the surrounding formula. The equation strip and bottom box use the same bold-italic serif math styling with color coding (black, blue, green, red). No bullet glyphs are used anywhere; the slide is diagram- and equation-driven.
